label: folio-assistant vocabulary (core only)
comment: Every class and property the folio knowledge graph projects, one node each. Generated by scripts/ns-export.ts; graph-kind definitions are read from the declaration registry rather than restated here.

@graph.label: Image
@graph.comment: A declared picture belonging to an instance, carrying its role, its layout and any text region.
@graph.definition: A declared picture belonging to an instance, carrying its role, its layout and any text region.

@graph.label: FolioGraph
@graph.comment: Authored content — the folio itself, rendered to a website.
@graph.definition: Authored content — the folio itself, rendered to a website.

@graph.label: PreviewGraph
@graph.comment: A staging target: the same folio built for review rather than for release.
@graph.definition: A staging target: the same folio built for review rather than for release.

@graph.label: UnknownGraph
@graph.comment: A declared graph kind nothing recognises — reported as its own state, never silently treated as empty.
@graph.definition: A declared graph kind nothing recognises — reported as its own state, never silently treated as empty.

@graph.label: LibraryGraph
@graph.comment: L1 source content — one `<bib-slug>/` per ingested document, holding `sections/*.md`, `structure.json` and, where the source was scanned, `ocr/page-NNN.txt`. Every knowledge-graph reference to a source resolves through here, never to a loose path or a bare URL.
@graph.definition: L1 source content — one `<bib-slug>/` per ingested document, holding `sections/*.md`, `structure.json` and, where the source was scanned, `ocr/page-NNN.txt`. Every knowledge-graph reference to a source resolves through here, never to a loose path or a bare URL.

@graph.label: TodoFeedbackGraph
@graph.comment: Feedback items — todos raised against a specific block, carrying the submitter's identity. Read by the `todo-review` skill.
@graph.definition: Feedback items — todos raised against a specific block, carrying the submitter's identity. Read by the `todo-review` skill.

@graph.label: TodoGraph
@graph.comment: Human actors' outstanding work — content, owned by the folio, tagged by role, process, task and identity. Its inner directories are declared by `todos/todos.json`.
@graph.definition: Human actors' outstanding work — content, owned by the folio, tagged by role, process, task and identity. Its inner directories are declared by `todos/todos.json`.

@graph.label: TodoItemsGraph
@graph.comment: Todo nodes — one file each, carrying `"$schema": "folio-todo/v1"`. Authored by people and by agents on their behalf.
@graph.definition: Todo nodes — one file each, carrying `"$schema": "folio-todo/v1"`. Authored by people and by agents on their behalf.

@graph.label: UploadsGraph
@graph.comment: The incoming queue — raw files as dropped, before ingestion. NOT L1, and not greppable as corpus: a document here reads as absent to every consumer.
@graph.definition: The incoming queue — raw files as dropped, before ingestion. NOT L1, and not greppable as corpus: a document here reads as absent to every consumer.

@graph.label: VoiceGraph
@graph.comment: Editorial voice profiles — one JSON each, carrying `"$schema": "folio-voice/v1"`. Every rule cites the ingested source or KG node it was derived from. Opt-in per folio.
@graph.definition: Editorial voice profiles — one JSON each, carrying `"$schema": "folio-voice/v1"`. Every rule cites the ingested source or KG node it was derived from. Opt-in per folio.
